programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: I Luangwadalen i Zambia lever Afrikas største og mest fryktinngytende kjemper, men det som virkelig gjør dalen spesiell, er fuglene. Det finnes over 400 ulike fuglearter her, og alle er perfekt tilpasset for å utnytte alle mulighetene som finnes.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Dra ut på episke reiser styrt av månens kraft. Se hvordan usynlige signaler styrer hvaler og skilpadders migrasjonsruter i havet, fly på tvers av kontinenter med nattravner, og se kompostbiller og andre insekter navigere ved hjelp av måneskinnet.

programme.title: Kimberley - Australias ville vestkyst
programme.desc: Unngå skjelldekte og fjærkledde farer med wallabyer, se krageagamer kjempe om maker, og bli med på etegilde med nyklekkede krokodiller. Utforsk farlige stryk og forstår den kulturelle og biologiske viktigheten av en lokal elv i regnsesongen.

programme.title: Ikoniske villdyr
programme.desc: Nilkrokodillen og flodhesten er to av Afrikas ikoniske amfibier som lever i ferskvann. De finnes i kanaler, elver og innsjøer på hele kontinentet, deriblant den storslåtte villmarken Kwa-Zulu Natal i Sør-Afrika. Disse to artene har eksistert side om side i tusenvis av år, og har utviklet seg på ulike måter til et liv i vann.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Trål havet med alle slags haier, og se hvorfor disse rovfiskene er overlegne under havoverflaten. Finn veien gjennom korallabyrinter med revhaier, ligg på lur for det perfekte angrepet med skjegghaier, og dra på en episk forflytning med hvithaiene.

programme.title: Vulkanske reiser
programme.desc: Etna i Italia er et av de beste stedene i verden for vulkantittere, og vulkanologen Tom Pfeiffer håper å ha flaks og få se et paroksysmalt utbrudd, et kort og svært intenst utbrudd som skaper spektakulære lavafontener.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australias havunderverk

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Afrika er et kontinent fullt av unike og fantastiske dyr med en tilværelse som har utviklet seg gjennom millioner av år. Afrika er også menneskenes fødested. programme.desc: Gå inn i ringen med naturens største slåsskjemper, som bruker vold for å få det de trenger. Se kannibaledderkoppen spise opp motstanderen, se den blodtørstige siden av koselige koalaer og få med deg en nakkeslengende giraffkamp.

programme.title: Planet Merkelig
programme.desc: Bli med på innsiden av de tøffeste gjengene i verden, og se hva pågangsmot er i naturen. Følg en flokk plyndrende gresshopper, se kokosnøttblekkspruten gå i bakholdsangrep og møt en flokk med finker som har fått smaken på blod.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: I en tåkete sørafrikansk skog vokser et seks hundre år gammelt Outeniqua tre. Med sine førti meter ruver hun høyt over over kalesjen og er en av de få som er igjen av sitt slag. Følg hennes fengslende historie, like unik som økosystemet i grenene hennes.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Elefanten Chilema har bare en halv snabel etter at hun mistet enden på snabelen i en krypskytterfelle som var satt opp for antiloper. Men fellen skiller ikke mellom dyr, noe som betyr at andre dyr enn de fellen var ment for, ofte blir fanget i dem – med katastrofale følger. Nå må Chilema tilpasse seg livet uten det viktigste verktøyet til elefanten. Hun må lære seg å spise, drikke og bade for å klare seg. Når hun i tillegg må hanskes med den tøffe tørketiden, kjemper hun for å overleve mot alle odds.

programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Vivaldi : Juditha Triumphans - Greek National Opera
programme.desc: Juditha triumphans Oratorio d’Antonio Vivadi (1678 – 1741) Livret de Iacopo Cassetti. Armonia Atenea, Il Pomo d'Oro, GNO Chorus, GNO Children's Choir. Athènes, Opéra National Grecque, 20 avril 2021. ‘Juditha triumphans’ est basé sur un livret latin de Iacopo Cassetti, lui-même inspiré du Livre de Judith de l'Ancien Testament. Le roi de Babylone Nabuchodonosor envoie son général Holopherne conquérir la ville de Béthulie en Israël. Pour sauver ses compatriotes israélites, la courageuse Judith décide de séduire Holopherne. Quand il s'endort, elle lui coupe la tête. ‘Juditha triumphans’ est le seul oratorio existant des quatre que Vivaldi a composés. L'intense atmosphère de guerre s’écoute dans les dramatiques parties chorales, et la foi et l'intégrité de Judith à travers l'écriture lyrique et tendre. Il convient de noter l'utilisation de nombreux instruments rares, tels que la viole d'amour, les chalumeaux et les théorbes dans les moments les plus significatifs de l’œuvre. Opéra.

programme.desc: När Viva träffade Michael, erbjöd han en trygg plats utan familjedrama. Men nu verkar det som att den trygga bubblan håller på att spricka. Michael drar sig undan och Viva försöker desperat få reda på om han döljer något eller kanske någon.

programme.title: Geordie Stories: Charlotte Mam of Two

programme.title: Hjortgänget
programme.desc: Har du nånsin förklarat offsideregeln på första dejten? Kommer fotbollstokige MGK, som jämför kärleksintressen med FIFA-kort, hitta sin match i Soho? Och kan Kim övertyga Geona, som bara dejtar storasyskon, att öppna sitt sinne och hjärta?.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.desc: Säsong fems Julia Carlson är tillbaka för att få upprättelse av inte en eller två utan tre missnöjda dukar.

programme.title: Ink Master

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: När det inte blir någon blixtutmaning tror tatuerarna att de har sitt på det torra, tills en oväntad vändning får dem att studsa till. Tatueringar av de Fyra ryttarna blir undergången för ett tatuerarpar.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood veta att Lolo är självsäker på mountainbike i 'Trapputförsåkning', lär oss att karma existerar i 'Skitsnackskarma' och avslutar med krockar i 'Tuktuk boom'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness går Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood på galna fester i 'Farofester', träffar riktigt elaka djur i 'Djurmobbare' och utforskar vattenplaningens hemska värld i 'Våta vägars vrak'.

programme.title: Geordie Stories: Charlotte Mam of Two
programme.desc: Charlotte är tillbaka som tvåbarnsmamma till Pixi och Alba, men sen Pixi föddes har relationen med Jake känts ansträngd. Charlotte åker på arbetsresa till Australien - men Jakes överraskningsbesök skapar problem för framtiden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: Joeys osäkerhet tar över när Lorena vill skapa ljuv musik med Patrick. David ber äntligen Lateysha om ursäkt, och det blir chockerande dubbel ankomst på stranden.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Architecte et urbaniste, Kenzo Tange est l'un des architectes les plus influents de sa génération; il a initié le Japon à l'architecture moderne, découverte dans le travail des maîtres. Il fut, en 1987, le premier Japonais à recevoir le prix Pritzker, la plus haute distinction mondiale en architecture. Il faut remonter à la défaite du Japon après la deuxième guerre mondiale et aux années qui ont suivi : l'occupation du Japon par les Américains, son absence de la scène internationale, sa lente reconstruction économique pour comprendre la vraie origine des 2 gymnases olympiques construits par Kenzo Tange pour les Jeux Olympiques de 1964. Il est rare qu'un bâtiment incarne autant d'ambitions : celles d'un architecte et d'une équipe de 25 jeunes architectes et urbanistes, celles d'une ville, celles d'un pays décidé à redevenir une puissance mondiale.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: C’est dans le centre de Buenos Aires qu’Eduardo Stupia a décidé d’installer son atelier entièrement dédié à la création. Dans une maison du XXe siècle, coincé entre deux immeubles modernes, il occupe un large espace dans lequel il peut se livrer à son art de prédilection, le dessin. Ses œuvres, qu’il décrit lui-même comme des paysages abstraits, sont tracées au crayon, au fusain, ou à l’encre de Chine. Dans ses compositions hétéroclites, où le langage graphique et la précision du geste tiennent une place centrale, Eduardo Stupia explore la sémantique du dessin et ouvre le champ de l’imagination.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates Stéphany Mora and Harleena will compete on an imposed theme. Today, the theme is vineyards. They will have one hour to take the best picture possible. Let’s see who will win.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Leonardo da Vinci.You will discover his labour with the Joconde, Salvator Mundi, The Cène.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherlands painter, Rembrandt.You will discover his labour with The night round, the return of the prodigal son, Danaé.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Of Spanish origin, Francis Picabia was an active member of the Dada group. However, being both provocative and iconoclastic, he soon began to scorn the serious nature of the avant-garde movements. His painting was at times realistic, at times abstract, and he sought above all to explore potential in art. This collection opens the doors of the Centre Pompidou (Paris) which presents some of Picabia’s major works, such as his famous “Cacodylic Eye” and “Adoration of the Calf”, recently acquired by the museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Situé en plein cœur de Paris, le musée du Louvre abrite une des collections d'art les plus impressionnantes à travers le monde, allant de l’Antiquité jusqu’à l’art moderne. Avec plus de 8 millions de visiteurs par an, le Louvre est le musée le plus visité du monde. A partir de cette collection, nous vous proposons de découvrir des œuvres d’art à ne pas manquer, comprenant « Mona Lisa » de Leonard De Vinci, « Les Noces de Cana » de Veronese, « La liberté guidant le peuple » de Delacroix et « La Grande Odalisque » de Ingres.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Le familistère de Guise, une cité radieuse
programme.desc: André Godin imagine pour ses ouvriers, dans la lignée des phalanstères de Charles Fourier, un habitat communautaire aux allures de palais. De 1860 à 1968, le Familistère de Guise, cité bâtie pour 1800 habitants par le grand industriel fouriériste Jean-Baptiste-André Godin (1817-1889), a été le théâtre d'une expérience sociale restée unique par son audace, son ampleur et sa durée. L'invention d'une architecture et d'un urbanisme "unitaires" est l'un des aspects originaux et pionniers de l'aventure familistérienne. Ce "Palais social" a constitué une véritable utopie en actes qui suscite aujourd'hui à nouveau l'intérêt des historiens, des sociologues, des économistes, des urbanistes ou des architectes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Rembrandt est largement considéré comme le plus grand peintre Néerlandais du 17ème siècle. Il est maître dans l’usage des lumières, particulièrement dans la technique du clair-obscur, c’est un dessinateur exceptionnellement talentueux. Le travail de Rembrandt a été considérablement influencé par les événements dramatique de sa vie ( La mort de sa femme, sa faillite financière, etc..). Dans cette exposition vous allez découvrir ses peintures les plus célèbres exposés au Louvre, comme « Bethsabée au bain tenant la lettre de David » ,mais également exposé à Mauritshuis avec « La Leçon d'anatomie du docteur Tulp » ou encore ces fameux autoportraits.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: C’est l’un des artistes les plus controversés et pourtant, l’un des plus influents. La collection de Picasso contenait principalement des Renoir. Matisse le vénérait. Monet également. Renoir a été crucial dans la création du mouvement impressionniste, avant de le rejeter totalement pour se lancer dans un genre radicalement différent, avec beaucoup de succès. La Collection Barnes à Philadelphie possède plus de toiles de Renoir que n’importe quelle autre galerie au monde et c’est là que nous tenterons de lever le voile sur l’histoire remarquable de cet incroyable artiste.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Red, art and utopia in the land of the Soviets
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Red, art and utopia in the land of the Soviets" at the Grand Palais in Paris. This exhibition focuses on how the communist project generated specific art forms throughout the Soviet period and more precisely from the October Revolution until the death of Stalin in 1953.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Women Sculptors, neither muse nor model
programme.desc: For very long time, women were excluded from doing sculpture. Yet, they never gave up struggling for their recognition as artists. As Women Painters, this one-off recounts the fate of the first female sculptors, and showcases their works, that are at last being acknowledged today...

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Leader of the School of Pont-Aven, Paul Gauguin, the most exotic of French artists, paved the way for modern painting. There were two main themes which marked his work: Brittany and Tahiti. A rebel, he rejected copying reality in favour of exploring more delicate painting techniques. You will discover here the most important milestones in his work: from “Four Breton Girls” to “Tahitian Women on the Beach”, by way of the surprising “Self Portrait with Yellow Christ”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Probablement le peintre le plus renommé du monde, Vincent van Gogh est née aux Pays-Bas en 1853 mais a passé la plus grande partie de sa vie en France.Souffrant de trouble mental, Van Gogh a produit plus de 2000 peintures avant de se suicider à l’âge de 37 ans. Pendant cette visite, vous allez pouvoir découvrir ses plus grandes oeuvres, avec notamment deux « Auto-portraits » exposé au Musée d'Orsay, « Les Tournesols » exposé à la Galere Nationale de Londres, « La Nuit étoilée », et « L’église d’Auvers-sur-Oise ».Bonne visite !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Alhambra is a palace, or rather a complex of two palaces built by two successive caliphs in the 14th century, Yusuf I (1333-1353) and Mohammed V (1353-1391). These two palaces are surrounded by an older fortress (10th century), crowning a 700-meter-long rocky outcrop with reddish walls (Al-Hamra means red). The two palaces are contiguous. They form a single complex organized around two patios. The overall plan is asymmetrical, with the two patios set at right angles to each other. Circulation is tortuous. In the 14th century, it's hard to imagine an architect who didn't like regularity and symmetry! Here, all is refinement: the earthenware mosaics on the floors, the sculpted plasterwork on the walls, the carved, sculpted and painted woodwork on the ceilings - everything is a declension of geometric, floral or epigraphic motifs. It's all part of a complex yet harmonious decor. To understand this distribution of spaces, so radically different from the Florentine palace or Renaissa.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous nous rendons dans la banlieue Sud de Paris. C’est dans un quartier tranquille que l’artiste Elias Crespin se rend chaque matin pour rejoindre son studio. L’artiste d’origine vénézuélienne, y a établi ses quartiers depuis près de 5 ans et y façonnent ses créations un peu particulières. Ses sculptures sont composées de figures géométriques simples, des lignes, triangles, carrés ou cercles, qui flottent dans l’espace suspendus à des fils presque invisibles.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates of the day, Thibaud Poirier and Antoine Guillou, will have one hour to realize their photo session. They will have to take the best possible photos on the imposed theme of architecture in the 12th district of Paris, and then they will have 30 minutes to edit their photos.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a British painter, William Turner.You will discover his labour with London from greenwich park, child hairdo’s pilgrimage, Snow storm.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Eugene Delacroix.You will discover his labour with The barque of Dante, Portrait of Aspasie, The assassination of the bishop of liege.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Au 16ème siècle, le cardinal Scipione Borghèse, neveu du Pape, fait construire une villa pour accueillir spécialement sa collection privée d’œuvres d’art, l’une des plus importantes de l’époque. Achetée par l’Etat italien en 1902, cette collection d’une immense richesse rassemble des chefs d’œuvres inestimables signés par les plus grands artistes. Découvrez ainsi l’une des copies de Léda et le cygne de De Vinci ou le David de Caravage. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Située sur la place Trafalgar Square à Londres, la Galerie Nationale est la maison d’une des plus grandes collections d’art Européennes. Celle-ci contient plus de 2000 peintures, allant du Moyen âge jusqu’au début des années 2000.Vous pourrez admirer des méthodes d’art et des œuvres d’artistes uniques au monde, comme la remarquable peinture flamande (Van Eyck, Vermeer), l’impressionnisme français (Monet, Cézanne) et surtout les maîtres anglais de l’art comme Hogart et Turner.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Richard Rogers and Renzo Piano, to meet the challenge posed to the architects, designed a building in the form of a giant Meccano, which immediately stood out in the Parisian architectural landscape. The architectural project, as described in the competition rules, had to meet the requirements of multidisciplinarity, free movement and open exhibition spaces. This competition was won by two young architects, the Italian Renzo Piano and the Briton Richard Rogers, by proposing a building in the spirit of libertarian architecture characteristic of the 1960s. The load-bearing structure and circulation, the escalator caterpillar for example, are rejected outside, leaving all the space for museum and activity spaces. Moored to the outside on the east façade, and used as cladding for the structure, the technical ducts stand out in four colors: blue for air, green for fluids, yellow for electrical ducts and red for circulation. The transparency of the main facade to the west allows observation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: William Turner est connu dans le monde entier pour être l’un des meilleurs peintres de paysages de l’école Anglaise. Il s’efforce de représenter des paysages dans un style considéré comme romantique. La progression dans son art lui a permis de se révéler au monde entier, de ce fait il s’est également permis d’avoir une plus grande fantaisie et plus d’audace dans son traitement des couleurs et de la lumière, se rapprochant de l’imaginaire. De telle manière qu’il est aujourd’hui considéré comme l’un des précurseurs de l’impressionnisme. Découvrez ses oeuvres comme " Le Dernier Voyage du Téméraire " exposé dans la Galerie Nationale à Londres, ou encore " Le Négrier " exposé au musée des Beaux-arts à Boston.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: For almost 500 years, a large painting showing two young women at a fountain has been seen as an absolute hymn to beauty and love, executed by the young Titian who had set out to conquer the Venetian art scene. It is a solemn, luminous song, looking onto a bright, harmonious universe; it is the first true masterpiece of the twenty-five-year-old painter who knowingly started revolutionizing the history of painting. As one of his contemporaries said, Titian “walks hand in hand with nature; all of his figures are alive, move, and their flesh quivers.” After changing hands several times among different Venetian collections, it was finally purchased by Cardinal Scipione Borghese in 1608 for the Roman collection to which it still belongs today. The painting soon lost all ties with the person who commissioned it, and came to be understood as a broad, universal allegory of love, of two possible forms of love; the “sacred” and the “profane”.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Bosch, The Garden Of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: This is Triptych of Earthly Delights: how did the great masterpiece by Jeroen Anthoniszoon van Aken, known as Hieronymus Bosch, come to be created, when was it painted, what was it used for, and what does it really represent? No one knows; for most of bosch’s works no documents or precise information about buyers exist. even the dating itself is complicated. Historians, archivists, and art critics have tried everything. A veil of mystery envelops his entire artistic production, giving rise to the most varied rumours but for now searching for clues in the local traditions, in the writings in latin, french, german and dutch, searching for possible iconographic precedents and parallels, peering into the murky mirror of magical rites and heresies, delving into alchemy treatises, and pulling out from the fog of history figures who had practically been forgotten. The search goes on, but for the time being we have no first-hand information. For almost all of bosch’s works, no conclusive d.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Piero Della Francesca, The Montefeltro Altarpiece
programme.desc: For us today the Montefeltro Altarpiece, preserved in the Brera Art Gallery in Milan, is the “Altarpiece by Piero” par excellence. It is surprising to learn however, that until the late 1800s no one would ever have dreamed of attributing this impressive masterpiece to the hand of Piero della Francesca. For long centuries it was a deeply-rooted belief that the painter of the work was a certain Bartolomeo Corradini, a friar-painter known by the funny nickname of Fra Carnevale. It is in this guise that the Montefeltro Altarpiece came to Brera in 1811 and all the catalogues of the Milan Art Gallery repeated Fra Carnevale’s name until the end of that century. Piero della Francesca was simply forgotten... His name and his works ended up literally in the dust of oblivion until they disappeared from the horizon of history... His critical resurrection happened however, in the early 1900s, the century in which the Master painter wielded a powerful influence on the art of the first decades….

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Wim Delvoye" at the Royal Museum of Fine Arts of Belgium in Brussels. This exhibition tries to represent the works of the artist Wim Delvoye as well as possible. You will be able to observe emblematic works of the artist such as "the tattooed pig".

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Completely Gouzou
programme.desc: Gouzous are small anthropomorphic characters that frequently appear as collages or more often as graffiti in the urban space of Reunion Island, but also in other countries. The author is the French graffiti artist Jace, originally from Le Havre, who lives and works in La Réunion.

programme.title: Raw Art: When one looks, one finds it!
programme.desc: This documentary travels to France to question the contours of Raw Art. Different experts try to define this kind of art.

programme.title: Street Art Lyon, viewpoints
programme.desc: The official art (with the co-ownerships) of the painted walls of Lyon hides its origins: the art of the wild graffiti.

programme.title: Printing photography
programme.desc: Photographer Bruno Dewaele asks Antoine Agoudjian for several large silver prints as he prepares an exhibition.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Né en 1866 à Moscou, Wassily Kandinsky est considéré comme l’un des artistes les plus importants du 20ème siècle. Il est notamment le fondateur de l’art abstrait. Il quitte la Russie pour aller en Allemagne lorsqu’il devient professeur à Bauhaus en 1922, et s’installe par la suite en France en 1933, laissant derrière lui un travail très abondant. Vous allez re-découvrir ses créations les plus emblématiques, principalement exposé au Centre Pompidou à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Le palais des réceptions et des congrès de Rome
programme.desc: Adalberto Libera fut une des figures les plus importantes de l'architecture du XXème siècle, une des plus emblématiques aussi : il fut à la fois un pionnier de la modernité architecturale et un fasciste convaincu, architecte novateur et architecte du régime. Contrairement aux nazis, Mussolini fait alliance avec le mouvement moderne, qui devient, pour l'architecture, le style officiel du Fascisme. En 1937 le régime lance un de ses projets les plus ambitieux : l'E 42. Il s'agit de créer pour l'Exposition Internationale de 1942 une nouvelle ville monumentale incarnant la nouvelle Rome Impériale.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous irons à la rencontre de l’artiste Erik Desmazières. Il est l’un des artistes graveurs les plus connus en France, et il est exposé à travers le monde. Il a apporté à cette discipline un peu désuète, une forme de modernité, grâce à ses paysages fantastiques imbibés de science-fiction remarqués tout de suite par les collectionneurs. Membre de l’Académie Française des Beaux-Arts depuis 2008, Erik Desmazières s’est tourné ces dernières années vers des paysages réalistes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Home is at Heart: Open and Strengthen Your Shoulders
programme.desc: An energizing sequence, Heart Flow encourages you to feel, rather than forcing your way through the poses. Explore your height while maintaining an intention to keep your heart lifted and spirits light. Enjoy the energy you create with this dynamic flow.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" is dedicated to an intense and motivating cardio session. Guillaume and Sabrina start with a full warm-up, emphasizing the importance of preparing the body for an energetic workout. The program includes two standing movement exercises, followed by two on the floor, each performed in four sets of 40 seconds. The goal is to raise the heart rate and strengthen the muscles by alternating between intense efforts and floor exercises. The friendly and fun atmosphere makes this session perfect for training in a great mood while pushing your limits.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses !

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Soften the Edges: Hips and Hamstrings
programme.desc: Soften the Edges is a sequence that encourages a sense of ease in both body and breath while moving through a dynamic series of confident poses. Tap into a quality of inner peace and learn toreturn to that feeling whenever you are most challenged, on and off the mat.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est la discrète Valérie qui va tenter de prouver que l'As de la déco, c'est elle. A 41 ans, cette Liégeoise est passionnée par le home staging ou l'art de mettre une propriété en valeur pour en stimuler la vente ou la location. Un précepte que Valérie applique d'ailleurs dans son intérieur.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tender and tasty, lamb plays a key role in festive cuisine but also in everyday cuisine. Julie sets off on the French roads to discover the different breeds existing across the country. It must be said that France has one of the most varied productions in the world. There are more than forty breeds listed in 5 categories. But more than the breed, it is the way in which they are fed that interests connoisseurs. Julie introduces us to producers and cooks of this refined dish!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie sets on the roads of France to talk about an essential product on French tables: cheese. More than a gourmet craze, more than an end-of-meal treat, cheese is associated with French gastronomy, and is also recognized as Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes her friend Séverine Ferrer, host and actress, to prepare pies. On the menu: gâteau patate (a Reunionese speciality with sweet potato) and a "Luarraine" tart, featuring all Luana's favorite ingredients (parmesan, pancetta...).

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes her friend Suzie Palatin to prepare West Indian cuisine. On the menu: chicken colombo, with coconut blancmange for dessert.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 1
programme.desc: He takes us to Petra in Jordan. We discover how the Nabataeans became specialists in collecting rainwater, which they managed meticulously. Then, we find ourselves in Las Vegas, on the verge of a shortage, and in Amman, Jordan, to discover the daily difficulties linked to the shortage and rationing of water. In Israel, the Dead Sea is disappearing. Due to intensive agriculture, the Jordan River and other rivers no longer supply it with enough water. In France, the Loire is for nature lovers, today a multitude of species have come to recolonise the river, including the famous wild salmon. In Jordan, in the red desert of Wadi Rum, we meet Khaleel Maiteq, who shares with us his life and that of his animals in a desert environment where water is a very rare commodity.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 2
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand surprises us with preserved landscapes. And sometimes even with vast spaces where man's imprint remains invisible. Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in favour of the protection of the environment and wildlife. From the tip of the African continent, he decides to take down the fences to let the animals roam freely, then he takes us to Cambodia to see if the tigers will disappear. Then we head to London to follow the chimpanzee or to France to study and save the bees.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Wellness cuisine is not synonymous with sadness and insipidity. It can be extremely gourmet, for a balanced way to indulge yourself. On this theme, Luana welcomes young wellness pastry chef Johanna Le Pape. Together, they will prepare recipes that are both tasty and perfectly balanced: corn pizza with vegetables and peach-cassis and verbena puffs...

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Mabally, 13, is a Bagyeli Pygmy. The equatorial forest where he lives with his family is the only world he knows. Every term, he has to cross the jungle to reach his class. It's a three-hour walk through the slippery clay hills of southern Cameroon.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tender and tasty, lamb plays a key role in festive cuisine but also in everyday cuisine. Julie sets off on the French roads to discover the different breeds existing across the country. It must be said that France has one of the most varied productions in the world. There are more than forty breeds listed in 5 categories. But more than the breed, it is the way in which they are fed that interests connoisseurs. Julie introduces us to producers and cooks of this refined dish!

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Nasta arrived in Mayotte one night in her mother's arms on a clandestine boat, when she was 4 months old. A little girl rescued from the waters, she crosses her shanty town four times a day to go to school. At the age of 9, Nasta walks alone through this maze of corrugated iron sheets. An hour and a half spent in the dust of a dirt track.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Luminita, 9, lives in Inelet, a tiny, isolated village in Romania's Carpathian mountains. Every morning, she wanders the mountain trails where wild dogs roam. Over an hour in nature as majestic as it is hostile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: William lives in the small village of Chala Pampa, Peru, the oldest civilization in America. At the age of 12, he walks more than 2 hours and climbs almost 1,000 meters to reach the only schools in the valley with his brothers and sisters.

programme.desc: En ce troisième jour de compétition, c'est Aurélie qui débarque. Avec son joli minois et son look rétro. Notre candidate est loin d'être une novice. Professeur d'arts plastiques et étalagiste, elle en connaît un rayon en matière de déco. Avec ces doigts de fée, Aurélie crée de jolies choses, Même si elle est du genre sûre d'elle. Notre prof préfère ne pas perdre la mesure avec le thème de la semaine « En avant la musique ! ».

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut. Julie will meet several producers in Ardèche, cook the traditional soup of the region with the sparkling Marithé. She will also make the recipe for homemade marrons glacés, before heading to Corsica to work with chestnut flour and the leaves of her tree. This journey will end as always with a clever chef's recipe, and this time it will be Claude Brioude who will do it! This chef likes to shake up the rules and will work the chestnut with fish, two seasonal products that we are not usually used to combining.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, pumpkin takes center stage. Luana Belmondo cooks a spiced pumpkin velouté with parmesan shortbread. Next, she prepares pumpkin gnocchi with a creamy cheese sauce.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo invites her friend Eleonora Galasso for a pizza party! First, they'll make homemade dough. Next, they'll cook a capriciosa with anchovies, capers and ham, and a pizza fritta with oregano and tomato sauce.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 2
programme.desc: We find ourselves in Israel in the Negev desert, Elaine is looking for solutions to combat desertification. The object of her research: trees, which consume little water. In Mali, we meet the Dogon: the desert farmers. He shows us his people's recipes for managing water. In this part of Mali, where it almost never rains. In Palestine, the village of Wadi Fukeen. A village where farmers use an irrigation and water-sharing system that is over 300 years old and based on respect and trust. And in Gaza, Palestine, where specialists are fighting to save Palestinian children made ill by unsafe water. In the Jordan Valley, where three countries in conflict face the same problems: the lack of water. In Brazil's water tower, where the exceptionally pure water is threatened by iron ore mining that pollutes the water table. And in Jerusalem, Israel, where sustainable development is only possible if people manage to make peace with each other, to live together.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: So the great rivers may live - Part 1
programme.desc: Water and its beauty, water and its power, water and its fragility... the water we all need is becoming scarce, through our own fault. Some rivers are dry, others are diverted, cut off by dams, others are simply polluted, and this for decades. We will discover how humans transformed the nature in Argentina, then in China and its disproportionate Three Gorges Dam. We will also go in Botswana with the Okavango, this unique river which flows into a desert forming the famous Okavango Delta. Vu du Ciel makes you discover once again another world, magnificent but threatened.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 2
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand surprises us with preserved landscapes. And sometimes even with vast spaces where man's imprint remains invisible. Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in favour of the protection of the environment and wildlife. From the tip of the African continent, he decides to take down the fences to let the animals roam freely, then he takes us to Cambodia to see if the tigers will disappear. Then we head to London to follow the chimpanzee or to France to study and save the bees.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a tour of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. In the kitchen, they bear witness to our relationship with others, reflecting our vision of the world. Julie's journey will introduce us to the famous black pepper, thanks to Erwann de Kerros, an insatiable pepper seeker. Aromatic plants will also be in the spotlight, as we pick them with Edouard Loubet in the Luberon...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan pancakes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: Japan - Okinawa - The Purpose of Life Part II
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your ow.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tender and tasty, lamb plays a key role in festive cuisine but also in everyday cuisine. Julie sets off on the French roads to discover the different breeds existing across the country. It must be said that France has one of the most varied productions in the world. There are more than forty breeds listed in 5 categories. But more than the breed, it is the way in which they are fed that interests connoisseurs. programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie sets on the roads of France to talk about an essential product on French tables: cheese. More than a gourmet craze, more than an end-of-meal treat, cheese is associated with French gastronomy, and is also recognized as Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: Norway - Friluftsliv (Open Air Life) Part I
programme.desc: We travel to Tromsø, Norway, to discover Friluftsliv, a philosophy that values reconnecting with nature for well-being. Alongside the Sámi people, we learn to live in harmony with the Arctic environment, even during long, dark winters. The deep bond between the Sámi and reindeer shows how nature is a source of happiness and healing.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. En dag skal han kanskje herske over sitt eget rike, men først må han lære å overleve. En tragisk bøffeljakt gir ham et første innblikk i hvor uforutsigbart livet på savannen er. Han blir stadig modigere, og hver utfordring tar ham lenger bort fra flokkens trygghet – helt til et eventyr på egen hånd fører ham rett i veien for flokkens største fiende: bøflene.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Når det gjelder overlevelse, bruker dyr i alle størrelser hemmelige våpen med dødelig presisjon. Fra bombarderbillenes kokende spray til sjøknelernes eksplosive klubbe og flygeagamernes skjulte vinger, ser vi nærmere på naturens mest fantastiske hemmelige våpen.
